string.name: wear_cwf_settings
string.comment: Button on the Wear screen, and title of the screen it opens: the settings of the Custom watch face, set from the phone

string.name: wear_cwf_settings_look
string.comment: Header of a group of settings: how the Custom watch face looks (seconds, date, dark, wake-up animation, ...)

string.name: wear_cwf_settings_shown_values
string.comment: Header of a group of settings: which values the Custom watch face shows (BG, IOB, COB, ...)

resources.string: The watch has not sent its settings yet. Until it does, the defaults are shown here.

string.name: wear_cwf_settings_set_by_design
string.comment: Shown under a setting that the user cannot change, because the loaded watch face sets it. Authorize custom watchfaces is the name of a setting in the wear settings.

resources.string: Set by the watch face, because of the setting \"Authorize custom watchfaces\"
